1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and __at least one aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said aero cover is integrally formed with said body panel as a single molded component__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __and said at least one aero cover comprises separate aero covers for each forward corner__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __and said first and second sections are non-contiguous__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, __wherein said first and second aero covers are removably attached to said body panel__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __and said transverse ribs are spaced at intervals of 15-25 mm__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __and said second plurality of transverse ribs are spaced at intervals of 15-25 mm__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs extend continuously along a longitudinal axis of said body panel__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are snap-fit connectors__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, __each buttress having a height of at least 40 mm__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, __and said open rib structures provide structural reinforcement to said buttresses__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, __wherein said first and second aero covers are removably attachable to said body panel and are not integrally molded therewith__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, __and said first and second sections are formed as separate components__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, __and each buttress has a minimum wall thickness of 4 mm__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __and said first fore-aft rib has a height of at least 8 mm__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __and said second fore-aft rib has a height of at least 8 mm__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __and said closed ribs are spaced at intervals of 30-50 mm apart__.
